title: Add destination_v24: continue the speed curriculum to 0.175 m/s
summary: destination_v24 is destination_v23 whose speed curriculum continues one step past 0.15 m/s to 0.175 m/s. Attempt 15 of destination_v23 mastered 0.15 m/s at update 747. The speed_v1 gait clock holds its 40-control cycle above 0.15 m/s, so 0.175 m/s needs 70 mm strides, beyond the 66 mm sideways reach that the +-0.35 rad action range allows.
next: Train destination_v24 on the surrogate from attempt 15's update-700 checkpoint and test it at 0.05 to 0.175 m/s.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
